skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the content, process, and methods for designing a survey.
Understand and apply various data collection techniques including interviews, observations, and document analysis.
Design effective questionnaires with appropriate question types and response scales.
Apply different sampling methods such as random and non-random sampling.
Measure and construct scales for survey questions.
Use statistical software like SPSS and R for data analysis.
Work independently and collaboratively in group settings.
Analyze and evaluate survey results critically.
Present survey findings professionally and effectively.
Understand ethical responsibilities in social research.
